statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nasdaq-100 futures remain materially lower before the U.S. open, but the contract has rebounded from its session low and cross-asset evidence is not fully aligned with a persistent no-retracement decline.
recommendation: Tail remains at the top of WATCH. The principal conditional danger window is the U.S. cash open, with a second headline checkpoint at the scheduled Treasury sanctions press conference.
headline: Nasdaq premarket weakness persists, but rebound from the low keeps Tail at WATCH
body: Delayed NQ data show the September contract near 29,205, about 0.6% below the prior settlement after trading as low as roughly 29,117. Technology and semiconductor weakness is notable, while lower Treasury yields and oil provide conflicting cross-asset evidence. Stress is extreme, but the pathological one-way path is not yet confirmed.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hourly ChatGPT assessments moved from mostly green Tail readings of 16-19% into WATCH at 10:00 UTC and 11:00 UTC as Monday premarket technology weakness intensified. The latest published hour reached Tail 24% without confirming persistent one-way structure.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours concentrate conditional Tail around Monday's U.S. cash open and the 18:00 UTC Treasury sanctions press conference. Tail should decay if meaningful retracements develop and headline transmission is absorbed; Stress remains high because major U.S. macro data and NVIDIA results arrive Wednesday.

forecast.analysis: NQ is about 0.6% lower in delayed data but has rebounded roughly 90 points from the session low; softer yields and oil conflict with a confirmed no-retracement decline.
drivers: NQ remains below Friday settlement but off the session low
Technology and semiconductor premarket weakness persists

news.title: US stock index futures slip as high-stakes Iran, inflation tests loom

forecast.analysis: The final pre-open hour remains a conditional whipsaw window. Tail stays in WATCH unless the opening auction confirms repeated downside extension with shallow or failed rebounds.
drivers: Opening-auction structure is not yet observed

forecast.analysis: The cash open is the primary danger window. Tail rises conditionally if selling extends through fresh lows, rebounds fail quickly, and semiconductors, megacaps and breadth confirm.
drivers: Fresh-low persistence is the key checkpoint

forecast.analysis: The first full cash hour carries the highest conditional Tail. Persistent one-way downside with shallow retracements would validate the elevated score; orderly rotation would invalidate it.
Post-open Tail is expected to ease if two-way trade develops. Continued fresh lows with weak rebounds would keep the opening danger window active rather than allowing decay.
Mid-session structure should reduce Tail if price rotates away from extremes. Technology weakness by itself remains a Stress driver rather than proof of pathological persistence.
drivers: Stress remains elevated into later catalysts

forecast.analysis: Risk firms into the Treasury sanctions press conference. The score is conditional on headline transmission; oil, yields and NQ would need to align directionally to lift Tail materially.

news.title: US Treasury Secretary Bessent to hold press conference on Monday

forecast.analysis: The sanctions announcement is a high-Stress checkpoint. Tail reaches the top of WATCH unless a persistent cross-asset second leg develops after the headline.
The hour after the sanctions event carries delayed-repricing risk. Tail remains below blocking levels unless NQ fails to retrace while oil, yields and technology weakness reinforce.
Later-afternoon Tail decays if the sanctions impulse is absorbed and NQ rotates away from extremes. Persistent headline-driven extension would keep WATCH conditions in place.
Power-hour risk is modestly higher because late-session continuation can amplify an earlier directional move. The score remains conditional on whether the day retains one-way structure.
The cash close can preserve WATCH if the index remains directionally efficient into the bell. A balanced close with retracements would support further Tail decay.
After the U.S. close, Tail falls below WATCH absent a fresh geopolitical shock. Overnight risk remains primarily event and headline Stress rather than observed one-way price structure.
drivers: No scheduled Tier-1 U.S. release overnight

forecast.analysis: Early Asia is expected to carry lower Tail if U.S. closing stress is absorbed. Renewed oil or bond-market dislocation would be the main conditional amplifier.
Asia-session Tail remains low under orderly cross-asset trading. A renewed technology-led selloff with failed rebounds would be needed to re-open a persistent-path concern.
The late-Asia hour remains structurally quieter. Tail would rise only if prior U.S. weakness resumes as a one-way move rather than a volatile but mean-reverting range.
Europe's open can reintroduce directional pressure. Tail stays low unless European technology, rates and NQ align and produce repeated extension.
European follow-through is a conditional test of whether overnight weakness persists. Two-way trade keeps Tail below WATCH despite elevated background Stress.
Mid-European trading carries limited Tail absent new headlines. The next material U.S. checkpoint is still several hours away.
drivers: No major U.S. release in this hour

forecast.analysis: Tail remains low before the U.S. premarket becomes active. Attention shifts toward Tuesday's housing data and renewed technology positioning.
drivers: Tuesday New Home Sales later at 14:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: U.S. premarket liquidity begins to matter again. Tail stays below WATCH unless overnight structure becomes one-way with poor retracement quality.
The next pre-open phase moves back to WATCH as Tuesday's cash session approaches. The score reflects conditional opening risk, not an observed future trend.
drivers: Housing data later in the session

forecast.analysis: The Tuesday cash-open window carries renewed WATCH risk. A clean two-way opening would reduce Tail, while repeated extension would raise it toward blocking levels.
New Home Sales at 14:00 UTC adds event Stress shortly after the open. Tail remains WATCH unless the release and opening flow align into persistent one-way structure.
drivers: Event surprise affects Stress before Tail

forecastDetail.comment: Observed premarket weakness is material but not one-way: NQ has rebounded from the low while yields and oil are softer, keeping Tail at WATCH.
Final pre-open risk remains whipsaw-heavy; opening-auction persistence, not the premarket decline alone, determines whether Tail rises.
Cash-open Tail is conditionally elevated if fresh lows persist and rebounds fail with broad technology confirmation.
The first full cash hour is the highest conditional Tail window; orderly rotation would invalidate the trend-down scenario.
Post-open Tail should fall if meaningful retracements appear; continued failed rebounds would keep the danger window active.
Mid-session risk eases if NQ rotates away from extremes; technology weakness alone remains primarily a Stress signal.
